column7: Review finding against the first version of #2744's fix in #2846 (never on main): ActivateMFA's MarkTOTPStepUsed-error branch returned a wrapped sentinel that writeMFAErr rendered as the generic internal-error message, while a wrong code got "invalid code". MarkTOTPStepUsed is reached only AFTER validateTOTPStep succeeded, so the two bodies told the caller whether the submitted code was CORRECT for as long as a DB fault lasted. Main (#3023) returns the plain wrong-code error on that branch and audits mfa.error. This handler-level test pins it: one fixture, a wrong code then the correct code with MarkTOTPStepUsed faulted; status, body and headers byte-identical, the body is "invalid code" specifically, and the audit still splits mfa.error from mfa.failed (so closing this cannot re-open #2744). Core-level assertions cannot catch this class: only the rendered response does. Timing is not covered.
